mapper.select: SELECT MAP_NO AS mapNo, CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo, CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, REPRESENT_KEYWORD AS representKeyword, PRIORITY AS priority, IS_ACTIVE AS isActive FROM OFT_PRODUCT_SEARCH_KEYWORD_MAP WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY PRIORITY ASC, MAP_NO ASC

SELECT MAP_NO AS mapNo, CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo, CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, REPRESENT_KEYWORD AS representKeyword, PRIORITY AS priority, IS_ACTIVE AS isActive FROM OFT_PRODUCT_SEARCH_KEYWORD_MAP WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND PRODUCT_NO IS NULL AND UPPER(CATEGORY_NAME) = UPPER(#{categoryName}) ORDER BY PRIORITY ASC, MAP_NO ASC

SELECT ALIAS_NO AS aliasNo, REPRESENT_KEYWORD AS representKeyword, SEARCH_KEYWORD AS searchKeyword, PRIORITY AS priority, IS_ACTIVE AS isActive FROM OFT_SEARCH_KEYWORD_ALIAS WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND UPPER(REPRESENT_KEYWORD) = UPPER(#{representKeyword}) ORDER BY PRIORITY ASC, ALIAS_NO ASC

SELECT CATEGORY_MAP_NO AS categoryMapNo, REPRESENT_KEYWORD AS representKeyword, RECIPE_CATEGORY AS recipeCategory, PRIORITY AS priority, IS_ACTIVE AS isActive FROM OFT_KEYWORD_RECIPE_CATEGORY_MAP WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND UPPER(REPRESENT_KEYWORD) = UPPER(#{representKeyword}) ORDER BY PRIORITY ASC, CATEGORY_MAP_NO ASC
